summary: In August 2026 an outsider accessed the visit log database of Jaranda, a South Korean home tutoring and learning platform, and stole subscribers' mobile phone numbers, names of children in lessons, visit dates and times, subjects and photos. Jaranda confirmed the breach on August 21, blocked the external access and set up monitoring for abnormal overseas transmissions.
